text:
Alex K: heads-up — low-volume canary repro: reads after prefix handoff sometimes return old KV for ~100ms. attaching micro-harness. logs: 
```
2026-03-22T11:02:01Z handoff start prefix=tenant/314 from=shard-2 to=shard-8 epoch=77
2026-03-22T11:02:01Z apply last_applied=77 prefix=tenant/314
2026-03-22T11:02:01Z read served_from_cache=true cached_epoch=76 owner_epoch=77
```
client-observed stale until next write. suspect ordering between advertise-owner and cache warmup/last-applied visibility. pinging eng-runtime for quick triage.

Maria D: thanks. any correlation with prefill latency? earlier incidents looked similar but we didn't rule out pubsub drops.

Alex K: prefill can lag ~20-80ms. ownership advertising is immediate to minimize handoff latency, so window exists.

Samir R: quick proposals: (1) read-side epoch guard (in-memory owner map check), (2) best-effort invalidation publish on handoff, (3) make handoff advertise only after local snapshot applied (atomic handoff).

Lee P: (1) cheap if owner_map is RCU snapshot; one mem lookup on hot path. (2) relies on pubsub — need fallback. (3) safest but increases handoff tail; significant control-plane change.

Alex K: pragmatic: land (1)+(2) behind flag, with cooldown to avoid thundering herd. open RFC for (3).

Maria D: ops note: invalidations cause rehydrates and GPU load. we need rate-limiting and a hint in the invalidation (prefill=true/false) so subscribers can choose to drop or prefetch.

Samir R: read-guard behavior: if cached_entry.epoch < owner_map[prefix] then do sync store read and backfill cache. emit metric evict.epoch_mismatch_count and histogram of added latency. add unit tests for lost invalidation and schema-versioned cache entries.

Lee P: invalidation message schema: {prefix, new_epoch, last_write_ts, nonce, prefill_hint}. we will implement a suppress window: if last_write_ts older than X ms, send hint prefill=false. also provide a server-side kill-switch.

Maria D: rollout plan: feature-flagged commit -> enable on small canary cohort for 48h -> monitor metrics: stale_reads, invalidation_rate, rehydrate_qps, p99 latency. ops will auto-roll back on rehydrate spike.

Samir R: i'll own the read-path PR + tests. will add cache-entry version byte for safe rollout.

Lee P: infra will add invalidation publisher + backoff knobs + debug nonce logging. will add an ops panic route if invalidation_fallbacks > threshold.

Alex K: i will draft the handshake RFC for atomic transfer. timeline: short term bits this week, canary 48h, iterate based on telemetry.

OpsBot: NOTICE: invalidation channel subscription created on canary nodes (3). monitoring hooks added.

Maria D: also run a quick customer-impact query to find tenants with stale-read occurrences last 7 days so CS can proactively reach out if needed.

Samir R: one implementation note: keep owner_map small and sharded per-thread to avoid cache contention. will microbench before landing.

Alex K: thanks team. circle back after canary or if we see regressions.
